messages:
Mina: Quick sync — Tallpine private rollout. Network flagged that metric uploads to our hosted telemetry endpoint are failing from the tenant VPC after NAT translation. Need a fallback path for perf logs before cutover. Who's the egress owner for this tenant?
Arjun: I own Tallpine's infra for the cutover window. seeing 502s from the sidecar when egress hits the proxy pool. likely SNAT exhaustion on the edge NAT. :thinking:
Selene: if it's SNAT exhaustion we can either increase ephemeral port range on their NAT gateway or route metrics through our centralized proxy in a different AZ. which option is acceptable for Tallpine (compliance)?
Mina: Tallpine wants no long-term routing through hosted proxies for PII reasons. short-term fallback to hosted proxy is OK for 2 hours during the canary. need approval from security or a signed exception.
Riley: Security ok with a scoped exception if we add packet capture disabled and retention set to 0. @Selene can you propose a minimal ACL & retention config?
Selene: yes. proposed ACL: allow only dst 3.22.44.11:443 (telemetry-redwood) from tenant subnet 10.56.0.0/22, egress only. retention: 0 days, no pcap archiving.
Selene: snippet for proxy route config:
```
route add 3.22.44.11/32 via 10.128.3.1 dev eth0 table 200
ip rule add from 10.56.0.0/22 table 200 pref 100
```
Arjun: that route looks fine. question: do we need to rotate the service certs for the sidecar when we shift route?
Mina: no cert rotation needed if we're only conservative routing; just ensure SNI preserved. we'll do a smoke post-route.
ops-bot: deploy-checker: Canary plan created — tallpine-canary-2026-03-18-1, owners: Arjun, Mina. Please acknowledge within 2h.
Riley: acked. Arjun, can you also add a health-check that fails open (so it doesn't hang clients) and a short TTL on route entries?
Arjun: will add a 5m TTL and the health-check that fails open. planning config push in ~20m.
Mina: thanks — after the canary and smoke, we need a handoff note for Support with steps to revert the proxy route. I'll draft the runbook.
Selene: also a reminder — airgap customers need signed artifact whitelist for the sidecar. Tallpine already sent the manifest but their signing key hasn't been uploaded to vault. @Mina can you ping the customer PKI team?
Mina: pinged PKI team (ticket #PKI-4782). asked for key upload ETA.
Riley: any CRs outstanding? I saw CR-934 (firewall rule) waiting on netops review.
Arjun: CR-934 updated with the TTL change, moved to review. Netops asked for one-liner justification. I've added it.
Mina: good. timeline: config push in 20, smoke in 40, canary window 2h after smoke. I'll post status updates here. :thumbsup:
